title: Repair and sign off per-layer PDP telemetry in NVDLA
summary: Diagnose per-layer PDP stall statistics and integrate banked request-phase telemetry into nv_small RTL and CSB.
taskPrompt: Repair existing PDP/PDP_RDMA stall statistics and implement the banked request-phase cycle and accepted-atom registers specified in the supplied TASK.md and SPEC.md.
evaluation: Twelve equally weighted v8 checks. Rebuild the complete Verilator model from output/rtl, then verify actual CSB reads, independent request events, tensor data, guards, CRC and component boundary behavior. Infrastructure errors are not zero scores.
